page.layout: One printed page with one column of index entries, in headed sections. The running head "INDEX" is centred at the top. The page number 94 is at the top right. Each entry has a number at the left and a page reference at the right. Stray marks lie at the bottom right.

main_text.l: De Infinitate & finitate, Cap. IV.
1 Quot modis aliquid dicatur infinitum aut finitum? 95
2 An ens recte & sufficienter diuidatur in infinitum & fi-nitum? 97
3 An ens primū & increatum simpliciter sit infinitum? 98
4 An prater primum ens adhuc alia dentur entia simpliciter
infinita vel actu, vel potentia? 102
5 An detur progressus in infinitum in vllo entium genere?
6 An omne ens creatum sit simpliciter finitum? 105
7 An vnum & idem diuerso modo ac respectu possit esse
fi-nitum & infinitum? 106
8 An inter ens simpliciter infinitum & finitum detur pro-portio? ibid.
De Illocalitate & localitate, Cap. V. 107
1 An ens recte diuidatur in illocale & locale? 107
2 An primum ens proprie dicatur esse in loco? 108
3 An primum ens sit vbique? 111
4 An vlla creatura possit esse vbique? 114
5 An omnis creatura sit in loco? 115
6 An vlla creatura simul possit esse actu in duobus vel plu-
ribus locis? 117
7 Quid sit locus in genere? 118
8 Quotuplex sit locus? 119
9 An sit discrimen inter locum & localitatem? 120[?]
10 Vtrum ad veram praesentiam entis semper & necessario
requiratur localis eiusdem propinquitas? ibid.
De Necessitate & Contingentia, Cap. VI. 121
1 An necessitas & contingentia recte numerentur inter af-
fectiones generales entis? 112
2 Quid sit necessitas & quotuplex? 113
3 An inter entia incomplexa solum primum ens in se sit
absolute necessarium? 114
4 An in entibus complexis locum habeat necessitas
absoluta? 116
5 An omne ens sit capax necessitatis hypotheticae? 117
6 An omne ens necessarium habeat causam sui necessitatis
& quandam illa sit? 118
7 Quot modis aliquid dicatur contingens? 119

page.notes: Printed "prater" in entry 4 is as printed (praeter). The page number of entry 9 is faint; read as 120, uncertain. The stray marks at the bottom right ("8 4") are not clearly printed text and are left out. The digitiser mark at the bottom right is omitted. Hyphenated line breaks in entries 2, 7, 8 and 6 are kept as printed.
